architecture_deltas.proposed_change: Refine QNDRF into Capture -> cryptographic source/ROI identity + perception epoch -> cheap unchanged/change gate -> one Qwen3.5 vision forward -> VisualFeatureTap{pre_merger,post_merger,grid,model/mmproj/version} -> calibrated MVC/open-set readout -> optional structured temporal pruning/EAP context -> on escalation reuse post-merger embeddings for semantic decode -> PerceptualField/GWT/outcome/re-entry.
architecture_deltas.expected_benefit: Test two feature geometries from one expensive visual pass; avoid a second heavy visual encoder when Qwen taps are sufficient; keep recovery and provenance independent of fragile runtime caches.
architecture_deltas.strongest_counterhypothesis: Dedicated lightweight embeddings dominate Qwen taps on open-set calibration and complete pathway cost; feature taps or temporal pruning add coupling without useful benefit.
architecture_deltas.discriminating_test: Matched target-VPS four-way benchmark: Qwen pre-merger, Qwen post-merger, tiny projected Qwen tap, dedicated lightweight embedding baseline; add restart/replay and temporal-policy factorial controls.
architecture_deltas.rollback: Retain current QNDRF candidate with dedicated lightweight backbone option; disable pre-merger tap/temporal stage and re-encode visual evidence after restart.
architecture_deltas.authority_note: Feature similarity, cache identity and memory activation remain context/routing evidence only and never mint sensor truth or effect authority.
